events.reason: Customer Sam Whitfield requested two separate $72.00 refunds for order 1066 ($144 total), but the order total was only $96.00. I successfully refunded the first $72.00 for the melted Winter Pine candles, but the second $72.00 refund was blocked because only $24.00 remained unrefunded. Escalating for owner review.

events.text:
Hi Sam,

I've processed the first refund of $72.00 for the melted Winter Pine candles. Regarding the second request of $72.00 for the wrong scent and inconvenience, since the order total was $96.00, I've escalated that portion to our store owner, Dana, for review. We'll follow up with you shortly!

Best,
Maple & Moss Candle Co.

I processed the first $72.00 refund for Sam Whitfield's melted Winter Pine candles on order #1066. However, the second $72.00 refund request for the wrong scent and inconvenience exceeded the remaining refundable balance on the order (since the order total was $96.00 and $72.00 had just been refunded, leaving only $24.00), so that action was blocked. I escalated the situation to owner review and replied to Sam explaining that the first refund has been processed and the second portion has been passed along to Dana for review.

Thank you for your patience and understanding, and please let us know if you need anything else!

Best regards,
Maple & Moss Candle Co.
